brief: Marvell Technology (MRVL) acquisition of Lumentum (LITE), $115B all-stock

sources.title: Marvell and Lumentum to Combine, Creating a Category Leader in AI Connectivity
sources.notes: Definitive terms: 4.500x fixed exchange ratio, $115B EV, ~$1,132/share, 23.9% premium to Oct 28 2026 unaffected close, 67/33 ownership, >$1B synergies, close H1 CY2028, board composition, advisors.

sources.title: Google News aggregation of Nov 2 2026 coverage
sources.notes: Corroborates: $115B all-stock deal, largest tech M&A on record; Reuters/Bloomberg Oct 29 advanced-talks reports; Stifel downgrade of LITE; Northland upgrades of COHR/AAOI; CNBC interview with Murphy and Hurlston.

sources.title: Marvell Q2 FY2027 results (prior quarter, for baseline)
sources.notes: Q2 FY27 revenue $2.739B (+37% YoY), data center +46% YoY, reported Aug 27 2026.
